title: ResearchProfile
description: One immutable Research Profile Version (OQ-02 section 1.1). It binds the provider and adapter, required capabilities, data semantics, market, calendar source, history range and cohort suite. Credentials are references only. Edits create a new revision for future work.

MarketSpec.title: MarketSpec
MarketSpec.description: One market and currency, one declared session calendar (OQ-02 section 2.5). instrument_identity PROVIDER_ASSET_ID: the stable instrument ID comes from the provider asset ID with its effective date; the ticker is kept separately.

ProviderBinding.title: ProviderBinding
ProviderBinding.description: Provider adapter and the capabilities the profile requires. credential_ref names a secret held by the owning host; it is never the secret. A failed entitlement probe blocks the profile. No automatic fallback.

DataSemantics.title: DataSemantics
DataSemantics.description: Financial data semantics. The profile declares them; provider defaults never choose them. A retrieval request repeats them and a dataset manifest records the semantics it applied. minimum_end_age_minutes: the end of a requested range is at least this old when requested.

BarAvailabilityRule.title: BarAvailabilityRule
BarAvailabilityRule.description: SESSION_CLOSE_PLUS_DELAY: a daily bar is available at its calendar session close plus delay_minutes, the declared data-ready delay. On an early-close day the delay runs from the early close.

ActionAvailabilityRule.title: ActionAvailabilityRule
ActionAvailabilityRule.description: How a corporate action's availability time is set. provider_field names the provider field that evidences the announcement date. available_at EFFECTIVE_SESSION_OPEN: the action is available at the open of its effective (ex-date) session, never earlier. evidence DECLARED_BEFORE_EFFECTIVE_SESSION: that bound holds only when provider_field holds a date strictly before the effective session. when_unevidenced BLOCK_PROFILE: an action in a run without such evidence blocks the profile; no fixed offset, record date, process date or retrieval time replaces it. Unknown availability stays unknown. Actions are never excluded.
